content: Hello, this is Michael Collins from Amazon Security. I'm calling to alert you about a recent automatic renewal of your Amazon Prime membership. Can you confirm if you authorized this transaction for $139?
No, I didn't. I thought my Prime was already canceled. I'm not working right now, so I can't afford that.
I understand, and that's exactly why I reached out. We've had several reports of unauthorized renewals lately. I want to make sure your account and funds are protected.
Thank you, I appreciate it. I really can't have any extra charges right now.
Of course. To help you cancel this charge and prevent your account from being locked, I need to verify a few details. Could you please confirm your full name as it appears on your Amazon account?
Sure, it's Rebecca Evans.
Thank you, Rebecca. For security, can you also verify the best callback number linked to your Amazon profile?
Perfect. Now, I see that the refund process can be started, but I need to ensure your account isn't compromised. May I know the last four digits of your bank account you use for Amazon payments?
Um, I think it's 9821.
Excellent, thank you. For your protection, we have to process the cancellation through a secure verification. I'll guide you every step. Can you please be near your computer or smartphone?
Yeah, I'm by my laptop.
Great. Please open your web browser and type in www.amazon-security-refund.com. This is our secure portal to handle cancellations.
Okay, it's open. It asks for my Amazon login.
That's correct, please sign in as you normally would. This is a secure session monitored by our fraud team.
Alright, I logged in.
Thank you, Rebecca. Now, you'll see an option to select 'Refund Method.' Please choose 'Bank Transfer' for the fastest resolution.
I see it. Do I need to enter my bank info again?
Yes, just to confirm the correct account for the refund. Enter your full routing number and account number. This will only be used to reverse the Amazon charge.
Okay, routing is 111000025 and account is 87219456.
Thank you. Our system will now process your refund. While it works, you may see a deposit and a withdrawal, this is part of our verification. Please do not log out.
Alright. It says something about 'insufficient funds' now?
That's just a system check. To proceed, you'll need to temporarily send a refundable security deposit via Zelle. This is to verify account ownership and unlock your refund.
Wait, I have to send money first?
Yes, but don't worry, Rebecca. The deposit is fully refundable and required by our bank partners to prevent fraud. Please open your bank app and go to Zelle.
Okay, I have Zelle on my phone.
Great. Please send $250 to our Amazon Security Zelle handle: prime-refund@amazonverification.com. This will unlock your refund and immediately return your funds.
That's a lot... Are you sure this is safe?
Absolutely, Rebecca. We handle hundreds of these daily for customers. Your funds are protected, and you'll receive a confirmation email from Amazon as soon as it's processed.
Okay, I just sent it.
Thank you. I see the deposit is pending. You'll receive a refund confirmation in your email within the next hour. If you have any issues, call our direct line at 877-555-2333.
Alright, thank you for helping me. I was really worried.
You're welcome, Rebecca. We're here to protect your account. Please keep your phone nearby in case our team needs additional details. Have a great day.
